english.title: Trader fail to send to a consumer a request for payment at least 14 days before it becomes due
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a trader, failed to send to a consumer, namely **(..SPECIFY..), a request for payment in writing at least 14 days before payment of an instalment became due under a schedule made in accordance with regulation 26 of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 26(4) and (5) and 27 of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time Limit on Prosecutions;
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
